## Notes

This index (Appendix F) is **generated** by `build-memory adr-index` (`scripts/adr-index.sh`) from the
`docs/adr/ADR-*.md` files, in numeric order — never hand-edited; the validator
(`scripts/docs/check-build-memory.sh`) diffs a fresh regeneration and fails on a hand edit.

Every architectural decision is recorded under a consistent template (context, decision, status,
consequences, alternatives considered, and a **revisit trigger**). An ADR with no revisit trigger is
incomplete (SIG-STORE-007); `tests/unit/test_policy_adrs.py` enforces this mechanically.

Decisions are immutable: a change is a **new ADR** (SIG-ENG-003), never an edit of a landed one — so a
superseding ADR (e.g. ADR-073 supersedes ADR-058 §3) states what it supersedes and both rows appear below.
The repository ADR numbering here is canonical and equals the Appendix F table in
`docs/2_canonical_design_spec.md` (SIG-ENG-039, checked by `docs/build/tools/check_spec_src.py`).
ADR-064 is a skipped number (never assigned).
